title: Offline: is the fan disabled, or read-only with nothing to tap?
detail: The PRD says everything is disabled offline with "Reconnect to change device settings." The design system prefers omission over greyed controls, and its disabled Segment measures 2.7:1 (the legibility floor is 4.5:1). The built screen shows one Offline notice carrying that sentence, and the fan row is read-only (no chevron, no sheet).
options: Read-only fan row plus the Offline notice (built)
Keep Auto, Manual and Save visible but disabled, with the PRD sentence beside them (needs a Segment disabled face that meets 4.5:1)
recommendation: Read-only fan row plus the notice: nothing is greyed, the reason is said once.

title: How does a gloved worker set the fan speed?
detail: The PRD fixes the range (0-100 in steps of 5) and an explicit Save, not the control. A slider is hard to land on a value with gloves, so the built sheet uses a stepper (5 % a tap). Moving from 45 to 100 takes 11 taps. Changing the fan now takes a row tap and a sheet instead of controls inline.
options: Stepper in a sheet, 5 % a tap (built)
recommendation: Keep the stepper; add presets only if the owner reports long runs of taps in practice.
